title: ESCALATE: Default type display — "-" vs default type name for untyped stories

text: {"type":"escalate","finding":"Default type display","severity":"Important","description":"DESIGN.md specifies that story_type: None should render as the default type from types.toml (e.g. 'type: story'). Implementation shows 'type: -' in story show and omits badge in list. This diverges from the design intent that every story has a displayable type.","options":[{"label":"Option 1: Accept current behavior","solution":"Keep '-' display, document it means untyped/default.
